citations.narrative:
Adult dogs were not tested for intestinal parasites in accordance with the schedule written in the program of veterinary
care (PVC). There were no records indicating samples were tested, and the licensee could not locate any records of
results since November 2024. The attending veterinarian clinic did not have record of testing performed in 2025 or yet in
2026. Puppies have been tested as directed in the written PVC.
Sampling for parasites is important for awareness of parasite load in the dogs and to identify if there is a need for
treatment.
Correct by following the schedule for sampling for intestinal parasites as indicated in the written PVC. Perform the tests
and maintain a copy of the medical record documenting the results.
This is a 1st Re-License Inspection for a Class “A” license. The inspection and exit briefing were conducted with the
applicant.
All items must be in compliance within 2 more inspection(s) or by November 2nd, 2026, or the applicant will forfeit the
license fee and must wait 6 months to reapply. Please contact your inspector to schedule your next Re-License
Inspection.
Regulated activity can continue under your existing USDA license until it expires.
